description: The back wall of the pit, faced in sheet steel that somebody went to the trouble of getting almost flat. Slags come off it hard and at an angle you learn or wear. The steel is dented in a loose constellation at chest height and one perfect crater up near the joists, which everybody has a different story about. Chalk marks on the floor show where to stand. The marks nearest the wall have been scuffed out and redrawn closer, twice, by someone with a point to make.
name: rebound wall
